# Sapwood

> Sapwood is a browser-based management UI for Heartwood ESP32 signing devices.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/sapwood): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
- [heartwood-esp32](https://github.com/forgesworn/heartwood-esp32): Firmware for the device Sapwood manages.

## Links

- [Sapwood app](https://sapwood.forgesworn.dev/)

- [Heartwood firmware](https://github.com/forgesworn/heartwood-esp32)
